description: Extend Channels.Api failure notice orchestration for partial receipts. Format safe rejected filename/byte-size/limit evidence, update first confirmed post without files or callbacks, carry confirmed final body into existing DeliveryConfirmation per-message persistence. Preserve report and successful attachments even on notice failure; no retry of delivered files. Action reuse: existing bridge upsert_message/send_reply and record_delivery_confirmation Event; local-only delivery policy and presentation helpers. Verify mixed-size and all-rejected cases, 15->14 two posts, durable next-turn history and no duplicate sends.

comments.text: The reproduced incident is a partial normalized delivery report. Fully rejected provider errors retain the existing generic transport failure behavior tracked in GitHub #893; this fix does not add provider error classification. Confirmed partial notices now update canonical response content as well as attachment metadata. No browser UI changes; integration exercises real adapter and Engine persistence with transport fixture.

title: [zaq-439] Report partial delivery through existing notice and history paths
